errors.text: The hypothesis replaces the target lamellar FCC/B2 Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy with predominantly single-phase, metastable FCC alloy systems.
It does not reconstruct the defining 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment or the resulting hierarchical coherent FCC/B2 interfaces.
The proposed experiment cannot test whether high pressure produces behavior unavailable through conventional thermal or thermomechanical treatments.
